methodology.timing: Wall time includes vp launch and all child processes; /usr/bin/time -l measures peak RSS and CPU on macOS
methodology.cold: Task caches removed, dependencies installed and OS file cache warm; not a cold machine

matchedCorpus.programNote: Matched typed tier explicitly includes every test in both sets of TypeScript configs. Test-source configurations in the real checkouts are unchanged for the real-workflow comparisons.

methodology.baselineHarness: Only command orchestration is translated to vp; original tools, source and test exclusions remain. Legacy test user-agent is fixed to its previous pnpm context. Node symlinks in baseline .bin directories ensure Node 24.18.0 for Turbo child workloads. Turbo cache is isolated.
methodology.engineTimeScope: Summary engine times are reported only for direct format/syntax lint. For multi-phase raw records, engineMs may represent the first reporting phase rather than total command duration.
methodology.baselineEnvironmentRepairs: Baseline was moved outside the main repository to avoid nested Biome roots. Local CLI links were regenerated; .bin/node links pin Node 24.18.0 for Turbo children. The exact locked satteri 0.10.5 native package was linked into the two apps after the fresh baseline SSR bundle could not resolve it. No application or framework source changes were made.

comparisons.note: Both build three packages, two examples, docs and design. Task caches are cleared; installed dependencies and OS caches stay warm.

comparisons.title: All seven workspace builds, warm task caches
comparisons.note: Policy differs: Turbo caches all seven builds; this VP candidate caches only the three library builds. Astro and example build scripts execute. This is configurable, not a Vite Task limitation.

comparisons.title: Full verification with cold task caches
comparisons.note: Task caches cleared before every sample; dependency installations and OS caches remain warm. Both must execute all framework tests. Includes packed installs and network-sensitive registry resolution.

comparisons.title: Full verification with warm task caches
comparisons.note: Normal warm-cache policies differ: legacy Turbo may replay tests/types; migrated executes tests/types and caches only package builds. Includes packed installs and network-sensitive registry resolution.
